create.name: Robyn Vogel
create.bio:
Robyn Vogel is a love and intimacy teacher based near Boston, Massachusetts, and the founder of Come Back to Love, the name she gives to both her method and her community. Losing her mother as a young girl shaped much of her early adult life, and she describes a turning point in her early thirties when she began to believe that close, joyful connection was possible for her too. In the years since she has studied with tantra teachers for around a quarter of a century, trained in Internal Family Systems and earned two master's degrees. In 2026 Koehler Books published Come Back to Love: A Path to Healing, which mixes memoir with the exercises of her Four Gates approach.

Her work is aimed mainly at single people, and some couples, who feel that love keeps slipping out of reach. Sessions and groups combine guided meditation, body-based awareness, conversation about the parts of us that hold back, and tantra-informed exercises done fully clothed. She runs local puja circles, an online membership and an eight-week programme, takes a small number of private clients, and leads retreats in Costa Rica and at Kripalu. She also hosts a weekly radio show and podcast of the same name, and trains coaches and other practitioners in her method.

books.title: Come Back to Love: A Path to Healing
books.author: Robyn Vogel
books.description: Part memoir and part workbook, this book follows Robyn's own long road back to trusting love after losing her mother in childhood. Alongside her story she sets out the four stages of her Come Back to Love method, with exercises for readers who want closer, more open relationships.

courses.title: Conscious Valentines: A Retreat for Spiritual Singles
courses.description: A Valentine's weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, for single people of any gender or orientation. Guided meditation, body-based practice and parts work sit alongside play and rest, and the weekend includes a ceremony honouring the relationship with oneself.

courses.title: Come Back to Love Retreat at Verdesana, Costa Rica
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat at Verdesana by Imiloa in Costa Rica over the New Year. Each day centres on a morning Come Back to Love workshop in a small circle, with tantra sessions on presence, consent and conscious touch, plant-based meals and time on the land.

courses.title: The Awakened Heart
courses.description: An eight-week online programme that pairs recorded lessons, worked through at your own pace, with a live weekly group call with Robyn. It looks at the patterns that repeat in relationships and how to choose partners from self-trust rather than old fears.

courses.title: Come Back to Love Membership
courses.description: An ongoing online membership with weekly live calls led by Robyn, a monthly group coaching session and a library of recorded tools on dating, intimacy and trust. Members also receive discounts on her retreats.

courses.title: Intimate Puja Circles
courses.description: Group evenings in the Boston area built on simple tantra-informed exercises, meditation and authentic relating. The circles are clothing-on and sensual rather than sexual, and are meant as a respectful place to meet other seekers.

courses.title: Love and Intimacy Coaching for Singles and Couples
courses.description: Private one-to-one work with Robyn on Zoom or in person, combining guided sessions, a personal plan for the relationship you want and messaging support between meetings. She takes only a few private clients each year, and a free introductory call is offered first.

flags: She describes herself as an IFS-trained psychotherapist and trauma-informed coach; her public offer is framed as love, intimacy and tantra teaching with a spiritual emphasis, so I listed her, but a human may want to confirm this is not mainly therapy.

Email robyn@comebacktolove.com is published on the contact page as 'robyn [at] comebacktolove.com' (for speaking and podcast requests) and as a Cloudflare-protected link (decoded); a team inbox OurTeam@ComeBacktoLove.com is also listed there.
Much of her marketing speaks to heartbreak, grief and divorce; item descriptions here avoid that framing, and divorce-specific videos were left out.
Tantra content (puja circles, Costa Rica retreat) is stated as clothing-on and consent-based; worth a glance before publishing.
City given as Boston because the contact page says she is in the Boston area; her exact town is not published.
left_out: Free Come Back to Love Journal (comebacktolove.com/free-come-back-to-love-journal): page returned a Cloudflare block, so it could not be checked.
Come Back to Love: The Course and the Inner Circle: no public page found beyond checkout links.
Divorce-focused episodes ('Beyond Divorce', 'Need Divorce Support?') and episodes led by guests (Kari Morin, Lisa Callahan, Penny Gold and Michael Trachman) left out of videos.
Short clips under ~8 minutes and the 'Get LUCKY' midlife arousal episode left out.
Book pre-launch bonuses (mother-wound journal, meditations) left out: only available after purchase.
